title: Create your first production
empty: text:Create your first production to get started. Each production keeps its scenes, cast, and rehearsal settings separate.

steps.say: Welcome to RehearseLines. In this walkthrough, we’ll create a production called The Clockwork Curtain, using the app’s production form.
From the Dashboard, choose Create a Production. That takes you to the Productions page, where you can see and manage your shows.
Select the plus Production button. The new production form opens above the list, with a name, a production type, and an optional description.
Under Project Name, enter The Clockwork Curtain. This is the name you’ll look for when you come back to work on the show.
For Production Type, we’ll use Play. You can also choose Musical or Film. Add a short description if you want a reminder of what this production is for.

actions.value: An original demo play for a rehearsal walkthrough.

steps.say: Select Create Project to save it. The Clockwork Curtain now appears under Your Productions, along with its type and the description we entered.
You now have a production in RehearseLines. You can return to this list whenever you want to find it again.
